design_description: A refined crimson-and-gold design built on The Apex template, focused on elegant curves and a clean athletic silhouette. The deep red base is complemented by flowing gold side arcs that rise from the hem and wrap subtly into the torso, giving the jersey movement and structure without relying on heavy graphics. Matching gold trims on the collar, sleeve cuffs, logos, and crest reinforce the premium royal-inspired identity. Overall, the design feels classic, noble, and performance-oriented — a minimalist execution with strong prestige and heritage energy.
